scope: Continuous microphone capture during Whisper inference with bounded pending queue
architecture: FollowSpeech requests the portable TranscribeSpeech capability; Capabilities2 proxy maps session IDs, heartbeat and results; the separate worker owns VAD and inference

configuration.overflow: discard and clear oldest pending segment; report dropped_segments

lifecycle.continuous_admission: explicit continuous=true; retained until release or terminal error
lifecycle.cancel: unsubscribe microphone, clear queued/current audio, ignore in-flight result
